page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The CPU cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. In CPU-bound tasks, the stress-ng single-core performance is measured at 1853.39, while the multi-core score reaches 7753.77. The Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores are 1525.0 and 5771.0, respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 427.91 GB/sec, which drops to 57.95 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write speed of 41.38 GB/sec. For database operations, the instance achieves 7.8 million Redis SET operations per second and a Passmark database operations score of 4025.71.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer predictable performance for general-purpose workloads without the risk of resource contention. However, the lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs depending on the application. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 10 Gbps. This hardware profile is suited for workloads such as static web serving, which achieved a throughput of 11.47 GB/sec in benchmarks, software compilation, text processing, and moderate database operations.
